title: Flow Field
description: Particle trails following a noise-based vector field.

title: Strange Attractor
description: A mesmerizing, evolving cosmic web based on the Peter de Jong attractor.

title: Interference
description: Op-art gratings read through a warped plane; the large shapes are the beat frequency between two ring sets.

title: Economic Tides
description: An abstract visualization driven by FRED data (interest rates, unemployment, and inflation).

title: Correlation Constellation
description: Eighteen US ETFs placed only by how their weekly returns move together, replayed from 2007; the cloud collapses in every crisis and separates again in calm.

title: Kaleidoscope Fold
description: A raymarched volume where six passes of fold-and-rotate smear space into a faceted tunnel; the seams glow where the ray grazes the distance field while a slow axis-angle rotation keeps the geometry from ever repeating.

title: Spiral Mandala
description: A recursive concentric mandala: each ring of small circles nests a tighter ring inside it down to a pixel-sized core, while ADD blending builds bright seams where the rings overlap and a frame-cycled hue drifts the whole figure through the spectrum.
